verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS virtual-mailbox service built on its own software platform, so publishing source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository, an open-source license, or any code availability. The docs cover only mailbox, forwarding, scanning and mail-center features, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.
